proposed_resources.source_capture: Freeze actual working-tree runtime bytes before production edits; no historical commit substitution, .env, customer media or ordinary records.
proposed_resources.preview: Two new independent private PostgreSQL clusters and real Django copies under tool-owned /tmp/motionmate-preview-session-* and /tmp/motionmate-preview-snapshot-* directories; verify UID/marker/process/data_directory/system_identifier and live DB identity before first writes.
proposed_resources.migrations: Apply only existing checked-in migrations to those empty owned databases/test databases; no schema or migration source changes.
proposed_resources.fixtures: Synthetic users/memberships/clients/requests/appointments/import jobs and read-only invoice/payment/review examples created only in owned setup/test phases; never copy ordinary data.
proposed_resources.writes: Browser create/edit/archive/quick-create/CSV confirmation and retry, login/CSRF/session operations and existing targeted backend tests only in owned resources; interactive runtime financial/platform writes remain blocked.
proposed_resources.tests: Create/drop runner-owned test_services_rollout only on the independently verified AFTER private cluster; isolated synthetic billing fixtures may be written by tests, never providers or ordinary records.
proposed_resources.browser: Existing installed Chromium executable and existing axe package only; local browser traffic limited to the chosen verified review/test servers. Capture 1440/768/390/320px, both themes, RTL/reflow/focus and raw failures.
proposed_resources.limits: No installs, ordinary DB access, live networking/providers/email/workers, schema changes, branch/worktree operations, staging, commits, pushes, merges, deploys or cleanup. Existing previews retained. Review launcher currently uses debug allocator; disclose as workaround and do not claim ordinary-runtime stability.
